_note: Deterministic demo scenarios applied by src/services/sim/scenarios.ts on top of baseline simulation (seed 'argus-2026'). All effects are SIMULATED and labeled as such.

scenarios.label: Silent infection (caught only by personal baseline)
scenarios.demonstrates: Values stay inside Earth and space ranges; personal layer escalates WATCH → WATCH → ACT (doc 08 TV-8).

scenarios.label: CO2 pocket near sleep stations
scenarios.demonstrates: Earth workplace limit (3.8 mmHg) passes some days while NASA-STD-3001 (3 mmHg) flags all days: missed by Earth.

scenarios.label: Sleep debt before a critical operation
scenarios.demonstrates: Typical 6-7 h in-flight sleep is EXPECTED; this drop is a real concern (WATCH/ACT) confirmed by reaction test.

scenarios.label: Vision change (SANS surveillance)
scenarios.demonstrates: Amsler diff vs previous map triggers WATCH and a vision protocol; small acuity change is EXPECTED with anticipation glasses.

scenarios.label: Solar particle event (replay)
scenarios.demonstrates: Radiation pillar with a synthetic replay (not a recorded event): S-scale rise, shelter advisory, modeled SPE dose, dose ledger update.

scenarios.label: Normal spaceflight adaptation
scenarios.demonstrates: EXPECTED state: Earth flags short sleep; space layer explains it as a known in-flight pattern.
